detail.title:
Electricity,
into motion.
detail.text: The electric motor turns electrical energy into rotation. A reduction gear transfers that rotation to the wheels.
detail.note: Control of motor torque gives the driver a responsive connection to the wheels.

items.label: Stator windings
items.text: Stationary windings create a rotating magnetic field.

items.label: Rotor
items.text: The rotor turns within the stator and drives the shaft.

items.label: Reduction gear
items.text: Gearing lowers rotational speed and increases wheel torque.

detail.title:
The energy
beneath you.
detail.text: A traction battery stores electrical energy and supplies it to the drive system. In this concept, it sits low beneath the cabin.
detail.note: A low, flat package leaves the cabin above it open.

items.label: Cell modules
items.text: Cells grouped into modules store the energy.

items.label: High-voltage connection
items.text: Orange connections mark the high-voltage electrical path in this illustration.

items.label: Protective enclosure
items.text: The pack housing supports and protects the assembly.
